description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 03rd Amendment of Service, Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service, which involves public service regulations, examination requirements, and recruitment procedures. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with public sector service conditions and recruitment standards, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). While it mentions government personnel (the Secretary), it does not focus on government structural changes or individual appointments with portfolio responsibilities, so it doesn't qualify for Types 1-3.
